concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-payouts-payout-service-view-transfers-details]] — 2019-modified, 2026-09-15-captured Payout Service-path Customer Area/Transfers API list, detail and bank confirmation-letter guide; explicitly requires Platforms integration, has inconsistent list-query examples, and sent instruction is not bank receipt.
warnings: List text requires an identifier and under-six-month range, but sample cURL omits identifier and narrative says May 2025–May 2026; do not resolve silently.
